decisive_spans.text: excessive calcification of elastic fiber fragments scattered in the reticular dermis (von Kossa staining)

response.rationale: The vignette describes classic symptoms of Pseudoxanthoma elasticum, including progressive skin laxity, yellowish papules, and calcification of elastic fibers. While Cutis laxa shares some features, the specific papules and calcification are more indicative of Pseudoxanthoma elasticum. Ehlers-Danlos syndrome is contradicted by the specific features mentioned.
